scripts.install:apps: npm install --prefix desktop && npm install --prefix http-server && npm install --prefix shell && npm install --prefix ws-server
scripts.build: npm run build:desktop && npm run build:http && npm run build:shell && npm run build:ws
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n desktop,http-server,shell,ws-server -c green,blue,yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix desktop" "npm run dev --prefix http-server" "npm run dev --prefix shell" "npm run dev --prefix ws-server"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n desktop,http-server,shell,ws-server -c green,blue,yellow,magenta "npm run start --prefix desktop" "npm run start --prefix http-server" "npm run start --prefix shell" "npm run start --prefix ws-server"
scripts.shell:dev: concurrently -k -n shell,ws-server -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev --prefix shell" "npm run dev --prefix ws-server"
